questions.question: If I skip a session, is there any way to earn back the in-class participation points I lost?
questions.referenceAnswer: There is no direct way to make up missed in-class activities. File the course absence form (at least one hour before class) so it is not a no-call-no-show, which would hurt the in-class activities grade; advance notice avoids the penalty but is not a makeup. Expect to be cold-called more often in later classes to balance participation, and missing too many classes eventually makes full in-class credit impossible. You are responsible for obtaining notes and handouts.
keyFacts: you will be called on more often later to balance participation
questions.sourceSection: Impact of Missing Class / Your Presence in Class

questions.question: How long is the Reflection essay supposed to be?
questions.referenceAnswer: 800 to 1200 words. Under 800 is unlikely to reach the depth sought and over 1200 is unfair to others. It must be a standard essay with an introduction, key points and a conclusion, in a consistent formatting standard such as APA, Chicago or ACM, written without AI tools.
